description: Source code implementing time window management functions for a device management system, including setting/getting status, mode, retries, starting/stopping timers, and saving/loading time offsets.

methods.name: timewindow_set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of a time window object to Idle, Started, or Ended.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_set_maxretries
methods.description: Sets the maximum retries value for a time window object.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_maxretries
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum retries value from a time window object.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the mode of a time window object.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a time window object.

methods.name: timewindow_start_timer_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when the start timer expires, sets status to Started.

methods.name: timewindow_end_timer_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when the end timer expires, sets status to Ended.

methods.name: timewindow_internal_del_info
methods.description: Deletes internal info associated with a time window object.

methods.name: timewindow_internal_add_info
methods.description: Adds internal info and timers based on current status.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_add_info
methods.description: Adds internal info to all relevant time window instances.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_del_info
methods.description: Deletes internal info from all relevant time window instances.

methods.name: timewindow_set_time_offset
methods.description: Sets the time offset (start/end) for a time window object.

methods.name: timewindow_get_time_offset
methods.description: Retrieves the time offset (start/end) for a time window object.

methods.name: timewindow_internal_start
methods.description: Starts timers for a time window based on its status.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_start
methods.description: Starts timers for all relevant time window instances.

methods.name: timewindow_internal_save
methods.description: Saves current timer remaining times into object properties.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_save
methods.description: Saves internal timer states for all relevant time window instances.
